The child preserves C05's three-recital structure and nearly the same three-part operative sequence: government and household flag display; appeals to Federal, State, and local officials and civic organizations to arrange ceremonies; and a call to citizens to renew and reaffirm commitment to constitutional principles. C06 and C17 are also close annual predecessors, but their distinctive wording is less extensively retained in the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Congress of the United States has
